tools.name: mizan_check
tools.description: Free. Returns avoid / caution / ok / unrated for an x402 endpoint or operator, based on what Mizan measured when it bought from them with its own money. Call this before any x402 payment.

tools.name: mizan_report
tools.description: Explains what evidence sits under a verdict for a given operator and how to buy it over x402. Does not itself cost anything.

tools.name: mizan_coverage
tools.description: Free. How many endpoints are on file, how many were actually bought, how many charge without delivering, and when the last survey ran.
